Chapter 7049: Enforcer Tribulation Pulse

Chapter 7049: Enforcer Tribulation Pulse

The waves only followed the path shot by the laser beam. As they approached, others realized they were tribulation lightning and fire in liquid form.

“That’s the enforcer’s tribulation...” An immortal became aghast since the waves appeared to be the first forms of tribulations.

When the enforcer avatar descended during Heaven Pit, she carried the ultimate tribulations. They targeted all cultivators proportionally with their cultivation. Thus, even celestial immortals were vulnerable.

They aimed at the weakest spots and were relentless, not stopping until death. Since they came from her, they were known as the enforcer’s tribulation despite containing numerous types.

She also used it as the energy source for her purest slash.

“Crackle!” Each ray from the waves could blind immortals.

“It still has the power of the enforcer’s slash...” Heaven’s Equal became afraid.

Upon hearing this, everyone immediately retreated from the path. After all, this slash cut down celestial and primordial immortals. Only Heavenfall survived, albeit with a heavy price.

The power of the slash remained in the oceans in Heaven Pit. Today, waves of it entered Dusk Realm due to Heavencrush’s laser.

“This is it!” Immortal Bronze celebrated.

“Crack!” The massive gun was reassembled with conduit pipes connecting with the pathway. It then absorbed the incoming waves of tribulations. Segments glowed radiantly as if the entire gun was charged with energy.

“It’s using the tribulation as energy fuel.” Immortals exchanged glances.

The enforcer’s tribulation was monstrous, tearing down immortals. No one could use it as their own. However, the gun created by Heavencrush had this ability.

“Buzz.” After absorbing all the waves, it emanated specks of light capable of blinding immortals permanently.

“Take this!” Immortal Bronze shouted at Li Qiye.

“Kill him with the enforcer’s power!” Ash-serpent became confident again since this slash had killed several celestial immortals.

“Enforcer Tribulation Pulse!” Immortal Bronze shared the same sentiment.

The colossal gun blasted an illuminating pulse. No other light could compare to its brilliance for they have been extinguished.

“Insane!” Heaven’s Equal shouted in astonishment.

“Rumble!” The pulse struck Li Qiye and affected the fabrics of Dusk Realm. However, it wasn’t unlimited since it only had the powers of the absorbed waves. Thus, the pulse receded eventually after being fully spent.
